title: Handle non-invoice or currupt PDF extraction
summary: E-document extraction now detects non-invoice or corrupt PDFs that return empty data and stops with a clear error, preventing creation of empty drafts and unnecessary vendor searches.
key_points: Detects ADI responses that contain only empty values, such as from non-invoice, blank or corrupt PDFs
Stops the structure step with a clear error instead of creating an empty draft
No draft is saved and no vendor search runs after a failed extraction
Valid header and line values are still kept and processed as before
Tests added for detecting empty extraction responses
